faqs.question: Can I join without experience?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. Over 40% of our members started with zero barbell or gym experience. Every new member begins with a complimentary 45-minute intake assessment where a coach reviews your injury history, tests movement patterns, and sets you up with safe initial loads.

faqs.question: Can I cancel any time?
faqs.answer: Yes! We stand firmly behind "No Contracts, No Excuses". All our monthly memberships can be paused or cancelled at any time through our member portal or front desk with just 7 days notice prior to your next billing cycle.

faqs.question: How do I book a class?
faqs.answer: You can book classes directly on this website or using the COREX Mobile App up to 7 days in advance. Live spot availability updates automatically so you always know when spots are open.

faqs.question: Do you offer day passes?
faqs.answer: Yes, single day passes are available for $20 (includes full open floor access) or $30 for a drop-in coached class. If you join on the same day, your day pass fee is credited toward your first month!

faqs.question: Is there parking and are there showers?
faqs.answer: Yes! We have 40 dedicated on-site parking spaces directly in front of the facility. Inside, we provide private rain showers, luxury changing rooms, hairdryers, and complimentary lockers.

faqs.question: What should I bring on day one?
faqs.answer: Just bring comfortable training clothes, flat-soled athletic shoes (or lifting shoes), a water bottle, and a small sweat towel. We provide all lifting chalk, belts, bands, and equipment on the floor.
